text.name: Full-Scale Invasion
text.rules: Record "full-scale war". SAE spends 3 points on one action. If SAE played this card, until the end of this turn, each time LIO spends points, it spends 1 fewer, never below 1. At the end of this turn, LIO spends 1 point placing influence. Raise Escalation by 1. If this card's event happens, remove it from the game afterwards.
text.history: Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine on 24 February 2022, twenty days after Russia and China declared a partnership with "no limits" in Beijing on 4 February 2022.
